summary: Iteration 38: Verified Dynamic PDF Quote Generator with Templates. All backend endpoints working correctly. Template vpos_pyme is available and PDF generation with templates produces valid PDFs > 500KB.

get_templates_status.description: Returns template status dictionary with exists/filename for each template type

vpos_pyme_template_available.description: vpos_pyme template marked as exists: true (file located at /app/backend/uploads/templates/vpos_pyme.pdf, ~935KB)

check_template_endpoint.description: Returns available: true/false for specified template type

generate_pdf_with_template.description: Successfully generates PDF using PyPDF2 to merge template with dynamic content. PDF starts with %PDF, size > 500KB, returns X-Template-Used header

preview_pdf_with_template.description: Returns inline PDF for browser preview

nonexistent_template_handling.description: Returns 404 with proper error message when template doesn't exist

frontend_template_detection.description: Frontend loads template status in fetchData(), uses templateAvailable[templateType]?.exists to detect availability, and conditionally calls generate-pdf-with-template or generate-pdf endpoint

context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF Template generation system is fully functional. The vpos_pyme.pdf template is uploaded and available at /app/backend/uploads/templates/. PyPDF2 is properly installed and used to merge template pages with dynamic overlay content created by ReportLab. The system supports pages 1 (cover), 2 (executive summary + distribution matrix), 4 (setup costs), 5 (recurring costs), and 7 (terms). Frontend correctly detects template availability via GET /api/config/templates and uses the appropriate endpoint based on useTemplateForPDF state.
